name: team_code under year+week axes returns one row per player-week when the player carries two gamelogs for that week
description: The player_gamelogs PK is (esbid, pid, year) and is NOT unique on week, so a player can hold two gamelogs for one week -- 20 such (pid, year, week) keys on production, every one naming two DIFFERENT teams. player_years_weeks_teams therefore groups and array_aggs rather than projecting ARRAY[team_code] row-for-row; projected raw, the duplicate fans out the player's week row through the LEFT JOIN in team-table-column-definitions. The seeded player has two 2022 week 1 gamelogs, one active on NO and one inactive on LV: he must produce ONE row carrying both teams.

seed: INSERT INTO player (pid, first_name, last_name, short_name, formatted_name, primary_position, secondary_position, date_of_birth, nfl_draft_year, current_nfl_team) VALUES ('TEST-TMCW-920021', 'Test', 'Tmcwa', 'T.Tmcwa', 'Test Tmcwa', 'MLB', 'MLB', '1998-01-01', 2020, 'KC')
INSERT INTO nfl_games (esbid, season_year, week, season_type, away_nfl_team, home_nfl_team, date) VALUES (971021, 2022, 1, 'REG', 'NO', 'ZFX', '2022-09-11')
INSERT INTO nfl_games (esbid, season_year, week, season_type, away_nfl_team, home_nfl_team, date) VALUES (971022, 2022, 1, 'REG', 'LV', 'ZFX', '2022-09-11')
INSERT INTO player_gamelogs (esbid, pid, opponent_nfl_team, nfl_team, player_position, season_year, is_active) VALUES (971021, 'TEST-TMCW-920021', 'ZFX', 'NO', 'MLB', 2022, true)
INSERT INTO player_gamelogs (esbid, pid, opponent_nfl_team, nfl_team, player_position, season_year, is_active) VALUES (971022, 'TEST-TMCW-920021', 'ZFX', 'LV', 'MLB', 2022, false)

expected_query:
with "base_years" as (SELECT unnest(ARRAY[2022]) as year), "player_years" as (SELECT DISTINCT player.pid, base_years.year FROM player CROSS JOIN base_years WHERE player.primary_position IN ('MLB')), "player_years_weeks" as (SELECT player_years.pid, nfl_year_week_timestamp.year, nfl_year_week_timestamp.week FROM player_years INNER JOIN nfl_year_week_timestamp ON player_years.year = nfl_year_week_timestamp.year WHERE nfl_year_week_timestamp.year = 2022 AND nfl_year_week_timestamp.week IN (1)), "player_years_weeks_teams" as (SELECT pid, year, week, array_agg(DISTINCT team_code) AS teams
          FROM (SELECT pgl.pid, 2022::int AS year, g.week, pgl.nfl_team AS team_code
       FROM player_gamelogs_year_2022 pgl
       INNER JOIN nfl_games g ON g.esbid = pgl.esbid
       WHERE g.season_type = 'REG' AND g.season_year = 2022) src
          GROUP BY pid, year, week), "player_participation_weeks" as (SELECT pid, year, week, bool_or(is_active) AS is_active
          FROM (SELECT pgl.pid, 2022::int AS year, g.week, pgl.is_active
       FROM player_gamelogs_year_2022 pgl
       INNER JOIN nfl_games g ON g.esbid = pgl.esbid
       WHERE g.season_type = 'REG' AND g.season_year = 2022) src
          GROUP BY pid, year, week), "player_years_teams" as (SELECT pid, year, array_agg(DISTINCT team_code) AS teams
          FROM (SELECT pgl.pid, 2022::int AS year, pgl.nfl_team AS team_code
       FROM player_gamelogs_year_2022 pgl
       INNER JOIN nfl_games g ON g.esbid = pgl.esbid
       WHERE g.season_type = 'REG' AND g.season_year = 2022) src
          GROUP BY pid, year), "team_weeks_played" as (select distinct "team", "year", "week" from ((select "home_nfl_team" as "team", "season_year" as "year", "week" from "nfl_games" where "nfl_games"."season_type" in ('REG') and "nfl_games"."season_year" in (2022)) union all (select "away_nfl_team" as "team", "season_year" as "year", "week" from "nfl_games" where "nfl_games"."season_type" in ('REG') and "nfl_games"."season_year" in (2022))) as "g") select "player"."pid", player.first_name, player.last_name, player_years_weeks_teams.teams as team_code_0, "player_years_weeks"."year", "player_years_weeks"."week", CASE
     WHEN player_participation_weeks.is_active THEN 'active'
     WHEN player_participation_weeks.pid IS NULL
          AND player_years_teams.teams IS NOT NULL
          AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM team_weeks_played
            WHERE team_weeks_played.year = player_years_weeks.year
              AND team_weeks_played.week = player_years_weeks.week
              AND team_weeks_played.team = ANY(player_years_teams.teams)
          )
       THEN 'bye'
     ELSE NULL
   END AS participation_status, "player"."primary_position" from "player" inner join "player_years_weeks" on "player_years_weeks"."pid" = "player"."pid" left join "player_years_weeks_teams" on "player_years_weeks_teams"."pid" = "player"."pid" and "player_years_weeks_teams"."year" = "player_years_weeks"."year" and "player_years_weeks_teams"."week" = "player_years_weeks"."week" left join "player_participation_weeks" on "player_participation_weeks"."pid" = "player"."pid" and "player_participation_weeks"."year" = "player_years_weeks"."year" and "player_participation_weeks"."week" = "player_years_weeks"."week" left join "player_years_teams" on "player_years_teams"."pid" = "player"."pid" and "player_years_teams"."year" = "player_years_weeks"."year" where player.primary_position IN ('MLB') group by player.first_name, player.last_name, player_years_weeks_teams.teams, "player_years_weeks"."year", "player_years_weeks"."week", CASE
     WHEN player_participation_weeks.is_active THEN 'active'
     WHEN player_participation_weeks.pid IS NULL
          AND player_years_teams.teams IS NOT NULL
          AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM team_weeks_played
            WHERE team_weeks_played.year = player_years_weeks.year
              AND team_weeks_played.week = player_years_weeks.week
              AND team_weeks_played.team = ANY(player_years_teams.teams)
          )
       THEN 'bye'
     ELSE NULL
   END, "player"."pid", "player"."last_name", "player"."first_name", "player"."primary_position" order by "player"."pid" asc limit 500
